title: Qatl abid shaam
body:
syed zaada syed e sajjad shaam ka bazaar
<<DIVIDER>>
sar barehna dekh ke maaon ko khoon rota raha
qatl abid shaam ke har mod pe hota raha
<<DIVIDER>>
berida binte payambar kaise guzri shaam se
baaghi baaghi ki sada kyun aayi balwe aam se
hurmate deen berida thi shaam kyun sota raha
qatl abid shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
gurbate sajjad pe roti thi keh ke bediyan
syed e sajjad ki ghairat karun kaise bayan
sar jhukaye shaam ke bazaar mein rota raha
qatl abid shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaatil e akbar ko laila dekh kar kehne lagi
kya bigada tha mere dilbar ne tera ay shaqi
maajra ye dekh ke ashkon se moo dhota raha
qatl abid shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ka bazaar dekha abid e bemaar ne
ki dua allah se ye khafila saalar ne
ye khula saydaniyo ka sar chupa de kibriya
warna likh rakhi hai meri maut is bazaar ne
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ka bazaar hai aur bekas o lachaar hai
zulm karne ko tamashayi sabhi tayyar hai
har tamashayi khada insaniyat khota raha
qatl abid shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
maadar e asghar chali hai raahon mein gathri liye
lakdiyan jhoole ki us mein aur dil e zakhmi liye
bekasi ye dekh ke sajjad khoon rota raha
qatl abid shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah mein gir gir ke bacche naaqon se marte rahe
aale imran pe sitamgar bas sitam karte rahe
gham wo saare karbala se shaam tak ddhota raha
qatl abid shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye hyder abid e beemar gash khaane lage
us ghadi rehan wo darbar mein jaane lage
ye mazalim karbala waalon pe bas hota raha
qatl abid shaam ke...
author: Haider Sultanpuri
